name: marketingskills_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the marketingskills capability.

prompts.name: seo_optimization
prompts.template: Optimize the following content for SEO with keywords: {keywords}. Content: {content}
prompts.use_case: Improving website conversion rates using AI-driven CRO tactics.

prompts.name: conversion_rate_optimization
prompts.template: Analyze this marketing page content and suggest improvements to increase conversion rate: {content}
prompts.use_case: Generating SEO-rich marketing copy for campaigns.

prompts.name: analytics_report_generation
prompts.template: Generate an analytics performance report based on this data: {marketing_data}
prompts.use_case: Analyzing marketing data and generating actionable reports.

prompts.name: growth_strategy_development
prompts.template: Suggest a growth engineering strategy for these marketing goals: {marketing_goals}
prompts.use_case: Developing growth strategies powered by AI assistance.

prompts.name: marketing_copywriting
prompts.template: Write compelling marketing copy focused on {target_audience} to promote {product_or_service}.
prompts.use_case: Automating marketing content optimization workflows with Claude Code.
